scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm:bundler && npm run build:wasm:web
scripts.test:token-sids:import: node --input-type=module --eval "import { normalizeTokenSids } from 'usfm-onion-web/token-sids'; if (typeof normalizeTokenSids !== 'function') process.exit(1)"
scripts.test:packed: npm run test:packed:types && npm run build:wasm:bundler:dev && npm run build:equivalence-emitter && node --experimental-wasm-modules scripts/test-packed-equivalence.mjs bundler
scripts.test:packed:web: npm run build:wasm:web:dev && npm run build:equivalence-emitter && node scripts/test-packed-equivalence.mjs web
scripts.test:wasm:bundler: npm run build:wasm:bundler:dev && node --experimental-wasm-modules scripts/test-web-package.mjs bundler && node --experimental-wasm-modules scripts/test-token-sids.mjs bundler
scripts.test:wasm:web: npm run build:wasm:web:dev && node scripts/test-web-package.mjs web && node scripts/test-token-sids.mjs web
scripts.test:wasm: npm run test:wasm:bundler && npm run test:wasm:web
scripts.golden:wasm: npm run build:wasm:bundler:dev && node --experimental-wasm-modules scripts/wasm-golden.mjs bundler
scripts.golden:wasm:update: npm run build:wasm:bundler:dev && UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 node --experimental-wasm-modules scripts/wasm-golden.mjs bundler
scripts.golden:wasm:web: npm run build:wasm:web:dev && node scripts/wasm-golden.mjs web
scripts.bench:wasm: npm run build:wasm:bundler && node --experimental-wasm-modules benches/wasm/run.mjs bundler
scripts.bench:wasm:web: npm run build:wasm:web && node benches/wasm/run.mjs web
scripts.bench:wasm:report: npm run build:wasm:bundler && BENCH_OUT=BENCH_RESULTS_WASM.md node --experimental-wasm-modules benches/wasm/run.mjs bundler
